title: Slice-match predicate and lookup-with-default are duplicated across build/read/update paths
description: The same two pieces of logic are hand-rolled three times: (1) the slice-match predicate `Object.entries(sliceKey).every(([k,v]) => String(e[k]) === v)` appears in the lookup build (line 76), in applyCellUpdates (line 113) and (as a sub-clause) in updateCell.matchRow (line 195-196); (2) the 'read value with default' expression `lookup.get(`${row}\x1F${col}`) ?? safeDefault` is wrapped in valueFor (line 82) but then re-inlined verbatim in the cell render at line 284 instead of calling valueFor. Extracting a single `matchesSlice(e)` helper and using valueFor(row,col) at the render site would remove the repetition and keep the slice/default semantics defined in exactly one place.
est_reduction: ~6-10 lines and three divergence points collapsed to one helper each
behavior_preservation: Pure refactor: matchesSlice(e) and valueFor(row,col) are already the exact expressions inlined at the duplicated sites; substituting them is behaviour-identical (same key construction `${...}\x1F${...}`, same `?? safeDefault`, same String() coercion).
